Proof in the paper: The X-ray powder diffraction (PXRD) patterns of the as-synthesized particles, as shown in Fig. 2, suggest they have a face centered cubic (fcc) structure, with peaks assignable to (1 1 1), (2 0 0), (2 2 0), (3 1 1), and (2 2 2) planes. The positions of diffraction peaks for pure Pt metal (70-2057, JCPDS-ICDD) and Pt3Sn alloy (or Pt75Sn25, 65-0958, JCPDS-ICDD) are included for reference.
